scope: Read-only forensic audit of saved original geometry and operator evidence. No candidate geometry was generated by this audit. Numeric component vectors below are rounded to seven decimals; exact arrays remain in the hash-bound source files.

source.hash_scope: These original-G7 hashes were verified during the preceding source/placement investigation; this documentation step did not reload or rehash the full native mesh.

finding: The main marked cups are inherited body coordinates that predate WALL redevelopment and Task32 additions. There is no single later ornament operator that created all of them. A G1/G2 finite-field axial attenuation is one bounded, evidence-motivated hypothesis, not a demonstrated cure for every cup.

identity_mapping.reason: connected_fold_growth.patch_growth._quarter_mirror constructs a canonical quarter and reorders vertex IDs. Current old-prefix IDs cannot be used directly as original WALL IDs.
identity_mapping.mapping_evidence: G03 SIDEWALL evidence.vertex_source_ids and mirror_signs retain original canonical WALL ancestry; G04 evidence.input_edges and source G03 faces describe later E/F births.
identity_mapping.identity_scope: For these three inherited vertices, actual G3 SIDEWALL XYZ equals the reflected original WALL reference_xyz plus delta exactly.

G2_component_scope: Norms of the actual component-vector means at each inherited G3 V/E/F birth. They are not sums of parent norms or whole-patch aesthetic measurements. The saved G3 reference equals the corresponding G2 parent mean exactly at all three roots.

G1_ancestor_of_current_7272.interpretation: The radial Task36 and field contributions nearly cancel at this ancestor while their axial contributions accumulate. Nonuniform independent axial movement is an observable intervention point; this alone does not prove that it causes every visually awkward overlap.

later_stage_exclusions.meaning: The supported Task32 directional-detail fields do not directly act at these roots. Neutral subdivision and later whole-body fields still change coordinates.
later_stage_exclusions.WALL_exception: Root43114 is a G4 edge birth from G3 SIDEWALL IDs7410/10101, mapping to WALL IDs1445/12176. Those two have upper WALL weight1 and WALL delta norms .3422319486/.2233852659. A WALL change could affect this small subgroup but would not address the three principal inherited cups.

single_revision_rationale.rule: Keep applied finite-field X/Y unchanged; multiply its Z component by 1-.75*w in one inherited-material band at G1 and G2. Keep Task36 and authored PCHIP coefficients unchanged.
single_revision_rationale.why: Preserve Mandel-derived radial shaping while reducing a measured, independently imposed axial pull competing with the authored fold flow. Avoid simultaneous changes to several source operators.
single_revision_rationale.safety_of_correspondence: Early material charts are used directly, before Task32's noninjective copied chart. A final same-topology splice requires exact faces/chart and source-association checks because geometry-based Task32 patch selection may otherwise change topology.
single_revision_rationale.scope_limit: The attenuated vector is not generally directed toward the nearest sampled outside target. Later geometry-dependent operators must be replayed on revised actual parents. Success requires actual matched renders; no complete cup repair, collision freedom, exact IAAC reconstruction or aesthetic success is inferred from component magnitudes.

rejected_approaches_not_repeated.reason: Parametric late-end rebuilding made thin angular plates and cut ends more prominent and weakened the rounded character.
Volumetric remeshing/finish was visually rejected as forced melting. The original G7 remains the source.
Independent added ornaments did not repair the inherited end silhouettes; additive ornament candidates are not used as source geometry.
